notes.title: Hadr Christmas treasure hunt and sale!
notes.content:
Hey there!
Hadr is 25% off during Steam Winter sale which means the whole bundle (game + soundtrack) is almost 50% off !
You can wrap your presents in it (but be careful, you know what it can do) or even better: You can give it to someone as a present if you like the game!

And update was made to the game and you can get a seasonal achievement (meaning you can only get it during winter sale) if you manage to find and disappear every single present in the game. There is one hidden in every room, thats all I am allowed to say!
Good huntin.

notes.title: Hadr is a game about a cloth and it made me feel like a serial killer
notes.content:
Hadr is an indie puzzle game that one would, I suppose, mostly describe as physics-based, if we were being very dry about it. You are a cloth, or several bits of cloth, depending on the level, and anything that you can cover up will vanish. A birdcage. A lamp. Most of a sofa. Whomph. Gone. I suspect is intended to be melancholic and floaty.

Except. Except. I found it incredibly sinister.
